newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-HAJDUK COME BACK TO BEAT MALMO 3-2.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HAJDUK COME BACK TO BEAT MALMO 3-2.

text.p: Substitute Mass Sarr scored a last gasp winner as Hajduk Split hit three goals in 12 minutes to steal a 3-2 win over Malmo in the first leg of the second preliminary round of the UEFA Cup on Tuesday.
The Croats dominated most of the game but the Swedes scored first through Jonas Wirmola in the 11th minute.
Niklas Gudmundsson made it 2-0 on the hour with Malmo's second attempt on goal.
Hajduk's Australian international Josip Skoko pulled one back in the 78th minute, Macedonia's Goce Sedloski levelled two minutes later and Sarr then grabbed the winner.
